reasons.claim: One eligible species lies beyond 250 m but within 1000 m: Sarcosoma globosum (EN, forest-associated, site-bound fungus; threats include lack of continuity forest, lack of large/old trees, ground disturbance in forestry). Nearest record 848 m, 2026, uncertainty 5 m.
No eligible species within 250 m: the only threatened record there is Coenonympha hero (VU butterfly, not felling-relevant, 233 m) and mobile birds.
Completed felling overlaps 7% (0.451 ha) of the polygon, well below the 50% threshold, so most of the 6.44 ha remains.

Effort is adequate (421 records, 92nd percentile) with 36 records on 6 days within 250 m and none inside the polygon, so the lack of eligible records nearby is better informed than at poorly recorded sites.

uncertainties: The EN record is 848 m away, near the outer ring; relevance to the polygon is unclear.
5 records within 250 m and 2 inside were dropped for coarse uncertainty, so some nearby records could not be used.
Other felling-relevant NT fungus (Sarcodon squamosus, 670 m) is outside 250 m and does not count towards the rubric.
not_established: That Sarcosoma globosum or other red-listed species occur on the polygon.
That absence of eligible records within 250 m means absence of such species.
Legal protection or legality of felling.
next_action: Human reviewer should check whether the polygon's remaining stand relates to the habitat of the 2026 Sarcosoma globosum record and the felling-relevant fungi at 670-850 m, and decide on a field check.
